source_text: Opposing viewpoints from FGM survivors and health researchers emphasize verifiable net harms, including elevated maternal mortality from obstructed labor, documented in prospective Nigerian hospital data showing cut women 1.3-2 times more likely to require emergency cesareans. [67]
